Part.UnendingCodex.Tooltip.message: Entry names and descriptions of characters, places and concepts in the Unending Codex.

Part.GoldSaucer.Tooltip.message: Text for GATEs, arcade games, chocobo racing, Triple Triad cards, Lord of Verminion and Doman Mahjong.

Parts.Intro.message: Untick a part and it goes back to English at the next start. Hover a box for what it covers.

Parts.NextStart.message: Changes here take effect when the game next starts.

Restart.Parts.message: You changed which parts are translated. The game reads all of its text once, at startup, so this takes effect the next time it starts.

Pack.Off.message: The game is showing its own text. The installed language pack is switched off.

Pack.Pending.message: A language pack is installed but not in use yet. Restart the game.

Pack.None.message: No language pack installed. Choose a language below and press Install.

Update.Checking.message: Checking whether a newer language pack is published...

Update.Available.message: A newer language pack is published: {0}

Update.Unreachable.message: No connection to the language pack update URL. If it persists, this pack will not update itself, so check where you got it from.

Update.NotDeclared.message: This language pack has no update URL, so it will never update itself.

Setup.UseFolderTip.message: Serves the folder in place. Press again after a rebuild.

Update.MoveTip.message: The pack moved. Reinstall from the new address to keep receiving updates.

Setup.OwnWrongPatch.message: {0}, built for game {1}. The game is running {2}, so it will be refused at startup rather than served. Rebuild it.

Setup.Unbuilt.message: No language pack available. Want to help translate it?

Restart.Serving.message: You changed the language. The game reads all of its text once, at startup, so this takes effect the next time it starts.

Boot.NotWaiting.message: Dalamud is not waiting for plugins at startup, so nothing is fetched then. Turn it on in Dalamud's settings.

Boot.WhereTip.message: It is on the General tab, called "Wait for plugins before game loads".

Pack.Served.message: {0} read(s) answered from disk this session

Pack.Fonts.message: {0} of {1} font file(s) served from the pack

Setup.PickerTitle.message: Select the folder your language pack was built into

Restart.Installed.message: The new language pack is installed but the game will not read it until it starts again, because it loads all of its text once, at startup.

Group.Other.Tooltip.message: Text this pack translates that this build of the plugin has no name for, listed under the game's own name for it. A pack in another language may well cover things this one does not.

Group.Other.PartDesc.message: This build of the plugin has no name for this one.

Group.Story.Tooltip.message: Text of the main scenario, side quests and cutscenes.

Part.QuestText.Tooltip.message: Shows the text when you talk to NPCs about a quest, the story summaries in the journal, the list of steps in the tracker and the quest pop-up notices.

Part.Cutscenes.Tooltip.message: Translates the subtitle lines at the bottom of the screen during voiced cutscenes.

Part.QuestNames.Tooltip.message: Translates only the quest titles (in the tracker, the journal and the Unending Journey).

Part.QuestNames.Warning.message: Names and text are separate parts. With only one of them on, titles and objectives are shown in different languages.

Group.People.Tooltip.message: Casual conversations and flavour text around the map.

Part.Talk.Tooltip.message: The text window that opens when you talk to NPCs with no quest (including Gold Saucer criers and vendors).

Part.AskAbout.Tooltip.message: The dialogue options an NPC offers when you ask about several topics, and the explanatory text of each option.

Part.Balloons.Tooltip.message: Text balloons over characters' heads as you walk by, and warnings shouted in combat.

Group.People.Warning.message: This is the largest part of the translation.

Group.Duties.Tooltip.message: Everything that happens inside combat instances and large-scale content zones.

Part.DutyText.Tooltip.message: What bosses and NPCs say inside a dungeon or raid, on-screen objectives, route votes in Variant Dungeons and the records of zones such as Eureka, Bozja or the Occult Crescent.

Part.Objects.Name.message: Objects and information in the world

Part.Objects.Tooltip.message: What a mechanism or lever tells you when used, plus documents, letters, signs and puzzle hints.

Part.DeepDungeons.Name.message: Deep Dungeon systems and unique content

Part.DeepDungeons.Tooltip.message: Elements exclusive to Palace of the Dead, Heaven-on-High and Eureka Orthos (pomanders, floor effects, demiclones) together with the field lore log.

Group.Finder.Name.message: Finder and guides (Duty Finder and tutorials)

Part.DutyFinder.Tooltip.message: The name of every dungeon, hunt, trial and raid in the list, the roulette explanations and the short guildhest tactics.

Part.ActiveHelp.Tooltip.message: The help pop-ups when you do something for the first time, and the journal tutorials.

Part.ContentGuides.Tooltip.message: Built-in manuals such as the rules of Mahjong, Triple Triad and the Island Sanctuary.

Group.Navigation.Tooltip.message: Names of aetherytes, Aethernet shards, ferries and travel menus.

Part.Travel.Tooltip.message: Names of aetherytes, Aethernet shards, ferries and travel menus. Lifestream looks these names up in English to know where to teleport you. Translated, navigation fails.

Group.Navigation.Warning.message: If you translate this, the related plugins stop working (example: Lifestream).

Group.SafeInterface.Tooltip.message: General visual elements that break no script.

Part.MainMenu.Tooltip.message: The options of the menu that opens with Esc, the title screen when the game opens, and character creation.

Group.Interface.Tooltip.message: Window titles, buttons, confirmations, shop windows and loot windows.

Part.Interface.Tooltip.message: Window titles, buttons, "Yes/No" confirmations, tomestone and exchange shop menus, and loot and coffer windows. Several plugins read the windows and buttons in English to interact with the interface. Translating them stops them from detecting those options.

Group.Interface.Warning.message: If you translate this, the related plugins stop working (examples: Yes Already, AutoRetainer, Pandora, LazyLoot, Deliveroo).

Part.Log.Tooltip.message: Everything that appears in the chat window (damage, emotes, gil notices, system errors, zone announcements).

Part.Log.Warning.message: Combat parsers and several plugins read these lines in English.

Part.Items.Tooltip.message: The names of every item in the bags and on the market board, and the names and descriptions of attributes (Strength, Critical Hit, etc.).

Codex.Enable.message: Link dialogue terms to the Unending Codex

Codex.Description.message: Highlight names of unlocked Codex entries in NPC dialogue. Click a highlighted name to open its entry. Click outside the name to advance the dialogue.

Codex.Login.message: Log in to use the Unending Codex.

Codex.None.message: No unlocked Codex entries are available.

Codex.Ready.message: Ready. Open a dialogue that names a Codex entry.

Codex.Failed.message: Codex links are unavailable. See /xllog for details.
